subject: Media Literacy
title: Teaching Social Media to the Next Generation
description: A fast breakdown of Teaching Social Media to the Next Generation for builders.

hook.text: A 12-year-old spends 7 hours daily on social media. Her parents spent zero hours at that age. No one taught either generation.

buildup.text: Each generation faces new media challenges. Teaching critical social media use is now a parenting essential.

discovery.text: Effective guidance includes open conversations, shared exploration, agreed boundaries, and modeling healthy habits.

twist.text: Banning social media entirely often backfires. Children need guided experience, not complete avoidance.

climax.text: The goal isn't to protect children from social media. It's to prepare them for it.

punchline.text: Don't ban the screen. Teach what's behind it.

quiz.question: What is the most effective approach to children and social media?
options: Guided experience with open conversations and agreed boundaries
